title: Software Engineer I - Payments
text:
About Tamarind Ledger
We run reconciliation software for 400 co-operative banks. Our stack includes Scala and Elixir services that you will not need to touch.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain payment APIs in Java using Spring Boot
- Write REST endpoints, unit tests and clear documentation
- Debug production issues with senior engineers

Requirements
- Strong fundamentals in data structures and algorithms
- Good understanding of object-oriented design
- Working knowledge of a relational database (MySQL or PostgreSQL)
- Comfortable with Git

Nice to have
- Exposure to Kafka or any message queue
- Docker basics
